_comment: Sonnet for most tasks. Reasonable limits, good quality-to-cost ratio.

"sonnet" is Sonnet 5.5 on the Anthropic API but Sonnet 4.5 ($3/$15, 200K; deprecated, retirement scheduled for 2026-11-30) on Bedrock, Google Cloud (Google managed, formerly Vertex AI) and Foundry, and Sonnet 4.6 on Claude Platform on AWS -- pin claude-sonnet-5-5 (Bedrock: anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5) there.

"haiku" is Haiku 5.5 on the Anthropic API (Claude Code v2.1.293+) but Haiku 4.5 on Claude Platform on AWS, Bedrock, Google Cloud and Foundry -- set ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL to pin it (it also sets the model for background functionality).
Best for: most teams, daily development, standard feature work.
Read(...) deny rules keep Claude's file tools out of deps, build output and secrets (.claudeignore is not a Claude Code feature).

The Stop hook runs each time Claude finishes responding (every turn), not once at the end of a session; SessionEnd is the event that fires when a session terminates (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks, read 2026-11-01).

hooks.command: echo 'Response finished - review token usage with /usage'
